barros2021.title: CARTmath—A Mathematical Model of CAR-T Immunotherapy in Preclinical Studies of Hematological Cancers
barros2021.license: CC BY 4.0; parameter values transcribed from Table 2, HDLM-2 + CAR-T 123 column
barros2021.parameter_order_note: Rates are per day; recall, suppression and killing are per cell per day; inverse_capacity is per cell.
barros2021.reference_discrepancy: Table 2 implies a lower tumor root of 1091.197 cells, whereas section 2.3 prints 1089 (0.202% difference). Table parameters are retained without adjustment; residuals and both numerical roots are reported.
barros2021.boundary: This is a CD123/HDLM-2 immunodeficient-mouse reference, not B-ALL calibration. The paper approximated BLI units as cells without an established conversion. Its other parameters were not uniquely inferred. No original experimental data or author code are redistributed.

lee2019.architecture: Anti-fluorescein CAR, FITC-folate adapter and folate-receptor-positive targets; preclinical study
lee2019.source_location: Results: Characterization of an anti-fluorescein CAR
lee2019.boundary: Use cell-binding Kd 30 pM rather than the isolated-antibody 270 fM. Reported human circulation half-life <90 minutes does not establish mouse tumor exposure or receptor residence times. Prototype free-adapter exposures and receptor totals are synthetic; no dose-to-concentration conversion or CRS fit.

hu2021.role: Clinical motivation for dual CD19/CD22 recognition; six-patient phase I CTA101 study. No patient-level calibration or claimed replication of CTA101 receptor logic.

synthetic_extension.role: All population-extension rates, antigen-contact rates, loss rates, starting mixtures and uncertainty bounds are illustrative design inputs, not measured B-ALL parameters.
synthetic_extension.review_context: Motivated by the author's 2023 analytical CAR-T review; review text and unpublished materials are not redistributed.
